meta.title: Deleting a section asks for confirmation

steps.note: Open the multi-stage event creation screen.
Configure the event with an RFP technical stage.
Move to the RFP stage before configuring its template.
Apply an available RFP template containing sections.

args.goal: On the RFP technical-stage questionnaire screen, locate a section with a Delete icon, click Delete, verify that a confirmation pop-up appears before any removal, confirm the deletion, and stop on the questionnaire screen showing that the selected section is no longer listed

steps.note: Perform and observe the section-specific deletion and confirmation flow that no dedicated catalog step exposes.
Assert the completed deletion flow left the application without an error.
